response.sql: WITH account_orders AS (SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM account AS a LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id), shares AS (SELECT account_id, order_count, CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE 1.0 * order_count / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `order`) END AS share FROM account_orders), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.order_count), 0) AS total_orders, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.value) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.value;
